info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Get Treasury By Param1-spec
info.description: The Treasury Management API provides secure access to detailed treasury information based on specified parameters. Users can retrieve balance sheet management data using the unique identifier 'param1', allowing them to analyze their financial position effectively. This API is essential for financial analysts and banking professionals who require up-to-date treasury metrics to inform decision-making. Typical use cases include generating reports, conducting audits, and monitoring cash flow across various entities.

get.description: This endpoint allows users to fetch detailed information related to the balance sheet management for the specified resource, identified by RES-100045. It provides essential insights and data crucial for financial analysis and decision-making.

200.description: Request completed successfully, returning the balance sheet data.
